answer_1.quote: We then generated 10 responses per prompt, totaling 1,000 responses.

answer_2.quote: We calculated the Spearman correlation coefficient ρ between user ratings of similarity (s_user) and each of the four existing metrics: Bert (s_Bert), BLEU (s_BLEU), Rouge (s_Rouge), and USE (s_USE). We also used Semantic Entropy (SE) and an ensemble of logit-based scores ...

answer_4.quote: We recruited 2,976 participants from Prolific, asking each to rate five unique response pairs from different prompts ... Participants rated the semantic similarity of five pairs of responses ... using a 6-point scale.
answer_4.guideline: Rate semantic similarity between a pair of responses on a 6-point Likert scale, with provided examples and explanations.
